description:
Cosmic Builders is competing in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge under the Hyderabad local event! We are working on the challenge: "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions."
Our team is looking for passionate members skilled in Software, Coding, AI/ML, Data Analysis, and UI/UX Design. If you want to build impactful tech to keep astronauts safe in deep space, join us!
